Marissa / Aditya - ran three scenarios, attaching a short memo (pasted key outputs below) and updated the workbook (redwood-pricing-model-1Mtokens.xlsx). Assumptions are at the top of the sheet.

Key baseline assumptions (expected scenario)
- Delivered inference cost to Redwood: $3.50 per 1M tokens (GPU/runtime $2.40 + infra + networking $0.70 + amortized cache/storage/ops $0.40)
- Avg tokens / user / month (from Alex): 3 sessions * 800 tokens = 2,400 tokens/user/month
- Customer target price: $15 per 1M tokens
- Conversion rate from free -> paid: 4%

Scenario outputs (expected)
- Cost per active user / month: (2,400 / 1,000,000) * $3.50 = $0.0084 (~0.84 cents)
- If FinTechX priced the feature at $3.00 / paid user / month and 4% convert on 50k MAU -> paying users = 2,000 -> revenue/month = $6,000
- Inference cost for paying users (2,000 users * $0.0084) = $16.80 / month (negligible vs revenue)
- Gross margin on inference line at $15/1M: (15 - 3.5) / 15 = 76.7%

Per-feature pricing guidance
- To get to >60% gross margin on the combined product (assume other costs add ~30% of revenue): we recommend pricing the assistant feature at $2.50+ / paid user / month (given the low inference cost, margin is driven by non-inference costs: product, storage, support)

CAC payback sensitivity (examples)
- If CAC = $30 and ARPU (average revenue per paid user) = $3 / month -> payback = 10 months
- If CAC = $30 and ARPU = $6 / month -> payback = 5 months
- At 4% conversion and 50k MAU, paying users month1 = 2,000. If they scale to 200k MAU with same conversion, paid users = 8,000 -> monthly revenue at $3/user = $24k -> payback calculus improves dramatically.

Notes / risks
- We assumed linear token usage and no heavy long-context sessions which would push tokens up 3x+. If they plan to let users upload large documents (summarization), re-run with doc-heavy gamma scenarios.

Next steps
- I'll export the workbook and memo to the folder. If Marissa wants, we can do a quick 30-min run-through with Alex to show the sensitivity slides.
- Rishi
